def test_encode():
    # Empty string
    assert encode('') == ''

    # Basic lowercase word -> swapcase then vowel shift (a->c, e->g, i->k, o->q, u->w)
    assert encode('hello') == 'HGLLQ'
    assert encode('HELLO') == 'hgllq'

    # Pure vowels
    assert encode('aeiou') == 'CGKQW'
    assert encode('AEIOU') == 'cgkqw'
    assert encode('aeiouAEIOU') == 'CGKQWcgkqw'

    # Mixed case with consonants
    assert encode('Python') == 'pYTHQN'
    assert encode('aBcD') == 'CbCd'

    # Non-letter characters unchanged
    assert encode('12345') == '12345'
    assert encode('!@#$%') == '!@#$%'

    # Words with no vowels
    assert encode('xyz XYZ') == 'XYZ xyz'
    assert encode('bcdfg') == 'BCDFG'

    # Multi-word sentence
    assert encode('I Am Test') == 'k cM tGST'

def test_encode():
    # Canonical examples
    assert encode('TEST') == 'tgst'
    assert encode('Mudasir') == 'mWDCSKR'
    assert encode('YES') == 'ygs'

    # Swapcase happens before vowel replacement
    assert encode('hello') == 'HGLLQ'
    assert encode('hello world') == 'HGLLQ WQRLD'

    # Edge cases
    assert encode('') == ''
    assert encode('aeiouAEIOU') == 'CGKQWcgkqw'

    # No vowels: only case is swapped
    assert encode('bcdfg') == 'BCDFG'

    # Non-letter characters are unchanged
    assert encode('123!@#') == '123!@#'
    assert encode('Python 3.8') == 'pYTHQN 3.8'
